rules.description: Caps Lock: tap = Esc, hold = Ctrl, Shift+Caps = Caps Lock
PC: Finder Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V cut and move files
PC: Ctrl+arrows / Ctrl+Backspace / Ctrl+Delete word editing (not in VMs)
PC: Ctrl+Y redo, Ctrl+F4 close tab (not in terminals, VMs)
PC: Ctrl+letter/number -> Cmd (not in terminals, VMs)
PC: Alt+F4 quits, Ctrl+Shift+Esc force quit
PC: Win (left Option) - tap = Spotlight, Win+arrows tiling, Win+Ctrl+arrows desktops, Win+E/D/L/Tab/Shift+S
